title: Deletion Proof Workbench: unknown is a result
audience: Developers who need to remove one export without confusing bounded static evidence with universal non-use.
promise: Inspect one symbol, separate known references from unknown consumer classes, require explicit apply, and keep a recovery reference.
story: An exported function is previewed with no bounded static references and a package export map still visible.
Explicit apply removes only that declaration and records the original text for recovery.
A second export with a known consumer is refused instead of being silently deleted.
Dynamic, reflective, generated, external, and stale-candidate boundaries remain explicit unknowns.
verified_locally: Current-dev source gate passes 3 tests, lint, and package checks.
Temporary Git fixture at 28f71408 previews and applies unusedThing with a recovery reference.
Known static consumer blocks apply and package export map remains an unknown boundary.
Dynamic, reflective, generated, and external consumer classes remain explicit unknowns.
The 1600×900 SVG/PNG preview is rendered and visually inspected.
open_gates: Exercise stale-candidate, generated, reflective, and failing-test negative fixtures.
Connect the receipt to Change Radius and Contract Watch without copying authority.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a current-dev bounded-deletion/refusal/recovery slice and a reviewed binary preview; it does not claim universal non-use, stale/generated/reflection/failing-test coverage, downstream parity, hosting, or publication.
